title: 支持定位与逐段确认

review.note: Round-1 blockers (locator integrity, C03 versioning, focus, cache isolation) fixed; awaiting round 2.

interface.repository: LocalRepository.writeConfirmationLedger(actor, matterId, expectedVersion, ledgerBlob, event, updatedAt) adds the narrow C03 write seam. It checks ownership/status/version, verifies that the confirmation event matches the actor/matter/current snapshot and one of confirmation.created or confirmation.revoked, then atomically writes matter.version+1, the event and the scoped ledger blob. A conflict writes nothing; an idempotent confirm returns before calling it.
interface.locator: SourceRefs are accepted only when the source row belongs to the requested matter and the derived source asset, the asset is available source material of that matter/tenant, the chunk id/hash/page/quote match, and SHA-256 of the live chunk text equals the stored hash. A revision whose input sourceVersion/configVersion/figureRevisionId differs from the current input marks every locator unlocatable and exposes no chunkText.
interface.focus: DraftReviewPanelView accepts optional RiskDTO[] and renders a 风险定位 section. Claim, source and risk controls focus the real DOM target: target nodes receive tabIndex=-1 and .focus() is called (plus a visible outline). The source chunk view is itself focusable. Browser evidence asserts document.activeElement for source, claim and risk.
interface.ledger: DraftReviewSession persists an actor- and matter-scoped ConfirmationLedger in LocalRepository blobs. Every non-idempotent confirm/revoke uses writeConfirmationLedger; the V6-05 transition remains the authority for confirmation validity and revocations.

acceptance.observed: A validated SourceRef traces to its chunk; confirmation persists an ai_paragraph record with local_self_reported identity, the actor, the revision SnapshotRef and one confirmation.created event. The matter version increments exactly once.

Missing chunks, hash mismatch, quote/offset mismatch and retired sources show 不可定位 and preserve the original quote. New probes reject a foreign matter source row, a foreign asset reference, altered chunk text with the old hash, and a revision whose sourceVersion is stale. Each probe asserts chunkText is null.

Repeating a live confirmation returns created=false with one record and no version bump. Revocation keeps the confirmation, appends one Revocation, bumps matter.version once and appends one confirmation.revoked event. A fresh session restores the same ids and pending state.

fixes.observed: readLocators now checks stored source matterId and derived asset ownership, asset purpose/tenant, live SHA-256 chunk text against the stored hash, and revision input freshness (sourceVersion, targetConfigVersion, figureRevisionId) before exposing chunkText. Probes: foreign matterId, foreign assetId, altered text with old hash, sourceVersion bump.

confirmParagraph and revokeParagraphConfirmation call LocalRepository.writeConfirmationLedger. It locks matter.version with expectedVersion, bumps version+1, writes updatedAt, the activity event and the ledger in one transaction. Tests verify +1 on confirm, +1 on revoke, no second bump on an idempotent confirm, VERSION_CONFLICT refusal without writes, and synthetic storage failure rollback of version/event/ledger.

DraftReviewPanel/View accepts risks and exposes a 风险定位 section. Claim, source and risk locator nodes receive tabIndex=-1 and DOM focus. Browser steps 02 and 03 assert document.activeElement for the source chunk, claim article and risk anchor.

limitations: Status remains candidate pending independent re-review. No commit, push, deployment, provider call, external network request, or real customer material was used.
Node 25.8.1 was available; the architecture specifies Node 22, which was unavailable and remains unverified.
The browser harness is a standalone synthetic LocalRepository + DraftEditor + DraftReviewPanel mount. V6App/navigation registration and native IndexedDB are not exercised.
Risks are supplied through the DraftReviewPanel risks prop. The panel does not fetch risks from a cloud check service; S05 preview risk rendering remains outside this R1 professional review ticket.

The accepted V6-05 confirm transition treats a repeated actor/kind/paragraph/SnapshotRef command as idempotent even after its Confirmation is revoked. This round did not change that product rule; the panel explains that a new revision is needed before reconfirming.
The build completed with the existing Vite warning for minified chunks over 500 kB.
The review artifact review-01.md is included in scope because it is an untracked file in the worktree; it was not authored by this implementation.

decisionsRequested.question: Can a user create a second confirmation for the same paragraph and SnapshotRef after revoking the first?
decisionsRequested.suggestion: Add an explicit confirmation attempt/idempotency identity or revise the V6-05 duplicate rule while preserving append-only history; until then the panel requires a new revision before reconfirming.
decisionsRequested.impact: The accepted V6-05 API returns the already revoked row on the same command and cannot append a new live confirmation for that same snapshot.
